No, you are not allowed to add another 3-credit elective this term.

Although you are eligible for a credit overload due to your CGPA of 8.82 (which is ≥ 8.5) [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §3], the add/drop period for the 2026-ODD term ended on 10 August 2026 [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §4]. 

Per policy, no courses can be added after the add/drop period has concluded [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §4].

**Current Status:**
*   **Total Registered Credits:** 25 [SQL]
*   **Add/Drop Status:** Outside add/drop period (The add/drop period for the 2026-ODD term ended on 10 August 2026) [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §4]
sql: SELECT SUM(c.credits) AS total_registered_credits, CASE WHEN CAST('2026-11-23' AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-07-31' AS DATE) AND CAST('2027-01-15' AS DATE) THEN 'Within add/drop period' ELSE 'Outside add/drop period' END AS add_drop_status FROM enrollments AS e JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE e.student_id = 'S2023ENTC001' AND e.term = '2026-ODD' AND e.status = 'enrolled' LIMIT 200
